title: lavatera triloba subsp. agrigentina
intro: Lavatera triloba subsp. agrigentina, commonly known as the Sicilian hibiscus or agrigentina mallow, is a plant species belonging to the mallow family (Malvaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Lavatera triloba subsp. agrigentina are attributed to its ability to modulate immune response and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
